issues.detail: The Greek 'ου κυριον αυτον καλει' means 'David does not call Him Lord'. The Vietnamese translation 'Đa-vít gọi Ngài là Chúa' incorrectly translates the negative particle 'ουν' (which functions as a connector/negation in this context) or misses the negation entirely, stating that David *does* call Him Lord.
